figurative_meaning_en: Shared seat; only place to sit
similar_in_english: Sitting on the same stool (implying poverty or closeness)
example_sentences_in_bangla: গরিব পরিবারে একাসনেই সবাই খেতে বসে।
তাদের ঘরে একাসনের অবস্থা, কোনো অতিরিক্ত আসন নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: In a poor family, everyone sits on one seat to eat.
Their home is in such a state of one seat, with no extra chairs.
note: Refers to extreme simplicity or poverty in traditional Bengali households
